精神（人物データ）
精神的な状態を表します。「ハイ」「元気」「リラックス」「通常」「不機嫌」「混乱」の６段階あります。
「不機嫌」や「混乱」のときは、仕事の効率が下がります。
精神状態は、航海士を[[111|個室]]・[[112|娯楽室]]に配置すると回復します。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Mood
records.english: An officer's mood has six states: Excited, Good, Relaxed, Normal, Upset and Confused. Upset or Confused officers work less efficiently. Assign an officer to [[111|a Private Cabin]] or [[112|the Recreation Room]] to improve their mood.
records.context: Original sea HUD or Sailor Info data help; source-linked neighboring articles and current plaque/condition/skill labels reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Six mental states; bad temper/confusion reduce work efficiency. Private/recreation rooms restore mental condition.
records.localization_note: Use the six current source-reviewed native labels, including Confused; preserve both recovery links.

体調が悪いと、担当の仕事の能率が落ちたり、仕事ができなくなったりします。
体調は、航海士を[[111|個室]]に配置すると回復します。「疫病」のときは、薬などのアイテムを[[114|船医]]が使うと回復します。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: Health
records.english: An officer's physical condition has six states: Healthy, Tired, Hurt, Wounded, Dying and Sick. Poor health reduces work efficiency or can prevent an officer from working. Assign them to [[111|a Private Cabin]] to recover. A [[114|Doctor]] can treat Sick officers with items such as medicine.
records.context: Original sea HUD or Sailor Info data help; source-linked neighboring articles and current plaque/condition/skill labels reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Six physical states; poor condition reduces/prevents work. Private cabin restores health; ship doctor using medicine/items cures disease.
records.localization_note: Use current Hurt/Wounded distinction. Preserve the Doctor-and-item requirement; do not add Dead to the source list.

ＨＰは[[99|一騎討ち]]などで傷を負ったりすると下がります。
０になると身体の状態が「瀕死」になります。宿屋に泊まったり、[[111|個室]]・[[112|娯楽室]]に配置されると徐々に回復します。
生命力はＨＰの最大値と身体の丈夫さを示します。高いと病気にかかりにくく、また、[[116|飼育員]]、[[126|甲板要員]]に向きます。基本能力の「体力」と「精神」が関係します。

records.speaker: Game help
records.heading: HP and Health
records.english: Injuries, such as those suffered in [[99|duels]], reduce HP. At zero HP, an officer becomes Dying. HP gradually returns when the officer stays at an inn or is assigned to [[111|a Private Cabin]] or [[112|the Recreation Room]]. The Health skill represents maximum HP and physical resilience. Higher Health makes illness less likely and suits [[116|Animal Keepers]] and [[126|Deckhands]]. It is influenced by Stamina and Spirit.
records.context: Original sea HUD or Sailor Info data help; source-linked neighboring articles and current plaque/condition/skill labels reviewed.
records.source_meaning: Injury/duels lower HP; zero gives near-death condition. Inn/private/recreation rooms gradually restore it. Vitality indicates maxHP/robustness, disease resistance and suitability for keeper/deck crew; Stamina/Spirit influence it.
records.localization_note: Health is the current vitality skill label, distinct from current physical condition. Preserve gradual recovery, five links and both related attributes.
